bosses.name: The Ashen Sentinel
bosses.title: Warden of the Fallen Courtyard
bosses.intro: He kept the gate when there was a kingdom behind it. He keeps it still.

phases.roar: The Sentinel's armour splits. Embers pour from the seams.

bosses.name: The Hollow Executioner
bosses.title: Last Justice of the Blackwood
bosses.intro: The sentences were all passed long ago. He is only catching up.

phases.roar: He drags the cleaver through the roots. Something under the wood answers.

bosses.name: The Crimson Widow
bosses.title: Mourner of the Cathedral Steps
bosses.intro: She was promised a wedding in the Cathedral. She has been waiting at the doors ever since.

phases.roar: She tears away the veil. There is nothing beneath it to pity.

bosses.name: The Cathedral Beast
bosses.title: What the Congregation Became
bosses.intro: They prayed to be made strong enough to endure. They were answered.

phases.roar: The bell above tolls once, by itself. The Beast rises onto two legs.

bosses.name: The Gravewarden
bosses.title: Keeper of the Sunken Crypt
bosses.intro: He buried every king of this line. He does not intend to bury another.

phases.roar: The water rises to your knees. The dead are holding it up.

bosses.name: The Frostbound King
bosses.title: Sovereign of the Frozen Citadel
bosses.intro: He ordered the gates frozen shut so that nothing could come in. Nothing has gone out either.

phases.roar: Frost climbs the walls. Your breath hangs in front of you and stays there.
The crown cracks. Winter is no longer something he commands. It is something he is.

bosses.name: The Forgotten Monarch
bosses.title: Last Ruler of the Hollow Reign
bosses.intro: You knelt to this crown once. It remembers. You do not.

phases.roar: The Monarch rises from the throne at last. The hall remembers how to kneel.
The crown burns white. Every king this hall has ever held stands up inside him.

bosses.name: The Pale Huntsman
bosses.title: He Who Follows
bosses.intro: You heard him three trees back. He let you.
